response.overview: Heesoo looks at the Platanus tree and thinks of her mother, who has forgotten. At her mother's house, which she has visited for the first time in a long time, two people face each other again with a long crack. Heesoo resents her mother but realizes that she was also hurt by someone. After a journey that crosses dreams and reality, will Heesoo be able to open the window of her closed heart.
response.title: The Giving Tree
